clean_repro.probe: POST /collections/test_pagination_dedup/points/search with offset-based pagination (offset=0,10,20) on 25 points
clean_repro.observed: Pagination returned non-overlapping results: offset=0 returned 10 points [0-9], offset=10 returned 10 points [10-19], offset=20 returned 5 points [20-24]. No duplicates were observed across pagination windows. Scroll API confirms 25 total points exist.

violated_assumptions: Assumption: HNSW approximate search should return duplicate points across pagination windows
Assumption: Offset-based pagination on approximate search is expected to have recall inconsistencies

contract_refs: Note: Contract does not explicitly guarantee deduplication across pagination, but offset-based pagination traditionally implies non-overlapping results.

source_grounding.source_excerpt: From grep search: Offset-based pagination in vector search is complex. The observed non-duplicative results suggest either: 1) this dataset/search doesn't trigger HNSW approximation edge cases, or 2) Qdrant implements deduplication logic that prevents point re-occurrence across pagination. The developer_cognition.json explicitly notes 'HNSW approximation duplicates in pagination' as a by_design pattern, suggesting duplicates are accepted limitations.
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: POST /points/search with offset → HNSW search with pagination → offset-based result selection → returned results show no duplicates in this case
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: HNSW近似搜索的分页重复在developer_cognition中被标记为by_design模式。观察到无重复可能是因为：1)数据集特性，2)搜索参数，或3)实际的去重实现。

falsification.probe: Verify pagination consistency - scroll API returns 25 points, search pagination returns 25 distinct points across 3 pages
falsification.observed: Scroll API confirms collection has exactly 25 points (IDs 0-24). Search pagination returns all 25 points exactly once across 3 pages. No duplicates found. This contradicts the assumption that HNSW approximation would cause pagination duplicates.

cognition_match.developer_stance: HNSW approximation duplicates in pagination are accepted as a limitation of approximate search algorithms
cognition_match.note: 直接匹配developer_cognition.json中的by_design_pattern #9523。开发团队明确将HNSW分页重复视为近似搜索的可接受限制。

verdicts.rationale: This case attempts to expose HNSW approximation duplicates in pagination, but the observed results show no duplicates. More importantly, developer_cognition.json explicitly lists 'HNSW approximation duplicates in pagination' (issue #9523) as a by_design_pattern with developer_stance 'Accepted limitation of approximate search' and should_report=false. This means the Qdrant team has explicitly stated that pagination duplicates in HNSW approximate search are an accepted limitation, not a defect. Even if duplicates were observed, this would be by-design behavior, not a bug.
